commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' The game has begun to heat up. Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90+4' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar.
90+1' Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul after Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) hacks down one of his opponents.
90+1' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
88' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alberto Mari (Valencia) replacing Hugo Duro.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Selim Amallah (Valencia) replaces Peter Federico.
87' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
86' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
86' Andre Almeida (Valencia) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Corner kick. Valencia will have an opportunity.
84' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

83' A great job from two opposing players there. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) fired a shot nicely in on goal from distance towards the bottom right corner, while Giorgi Mamardashvili produced a wonderful piece of goalkeeping to parry the ball onto the post. Rayo Vallecano earn a corner.
81' Substitution. Oscar Valentin makes way for Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
79' Peter Federico (Valencia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
76' Substitution. Alvaro Garcia is replaced by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano).
76' Ruben Baraja decides to make a substitution. Javi Guerra will be replaced by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
76' Substitution. Thierry Correia did his best and is replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
75' The attendance is 42642.
74' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul and Juan Pulido immediately signals a free kick.
74' The Valencia players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
68' Valencia quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Valencia get a corner.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
66' Inigo Perez prepares a substitution. Miguel Crespo is replaced by Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
66' The manager makes a subsitution with Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) coming on for Jorge de Frutos.
64' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.
61' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
60' The substitution has been made. Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) has replaced Sergi Canos.
58' It must be a yellow card. It is. Thierry Correia (Valencia) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
57' A pass by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
55' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
52' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
50' Sergi Canos (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stole Dimitrievski intercepts the ball.
47' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
46' Inigo Perez makes a half-time substitution. Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) comes on in place of Oscar Trejo.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.

43' Sergi Canos (Valencia) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
43' Peter Federico (Valencia) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.

40' That didn't go as planned! Peter Federico (Valencia) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Stole Dimitrievski, who easily kept it out.
37' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' Peter Federico (Valencia) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Stole Dimitrievski makes a simple save.
33' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
29' Rayo Vallecano take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

28' Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a great save to deny Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rayo Vallecano are going to take it.
27' Half-chance! Diego Lopez (Valencia) plays a pass into the box, but Stole Dimitrievski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
26' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul.
24' The foul by Thierry Correia (Valencia) was seen by Juan Pulido who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
21' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.

20' Close! Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
18' Alfonso Espino (Rayo Vallecano) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
15' The Rayo Vallecano players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
12' Sergi Canos (Valencia) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
9' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.

8' Peter Federico (Valencia) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Valencia.
5' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' Javi Guerra (Valencia) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Valencia force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
